about.name: Praveen Prasad
about.title: Full Stack Developer
about.bio: Full-stack developer based in Malappuram, Kerala. I build considered interfaces, connected web applications, and practical automations with React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and n8n. My approach is hands-on: understand the problem, make it work, and refine the details.

experiences.title: Senior Frontend Developer
experiences.description: Building web applications with Next.js and TypeScript, contributing full-stack features, and connecting workflows with n8n. I learned new tools as the work required and applied them to practical product needs.

experiences.title: Web Developer
experiences.description: Developed responsive websites and application features with React, Node.js, and WordPress. Worked across frontend and backend implementation to bring project requirements into usable web experiences.

services.title: Web applications
services.description: From the first screen to the API behind it: connected applications built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Node.js, with a structure that is straightforward to extend.

services.title: Interfaces & interaction
services.description: Responsive layouts, purposeful motion, and accessible components. I translate a design into an interface that feels clear and behaves consistently.

services.title: Content-driven websites
services.description: WordPress themes, plugins, and content sites that give your team a practical way to publish and keep your website current.

services.title: Connected workflows
services.description: n8n automations that move information between APIs, CRMs, and internal tools, reducing the repetitive steps between systems.

services.title: Online storefronts
services.description: Shopify storefronts and shopping flows that make products easy to explore, with an implementation your business can maintain.

services.title: Technical collaboration
services.description: A second pair of eyes on architecture, code, and implementation decisions, plus hands-on guidance for teams working toward a release.

projects.title: Product Share
projects.description: A SaaS platform that gives small entrepreneurs a straightforward way to create product catalogues and share them with customers.

projects.title: Beegains Academy
projects.description: A learning-focused website paired with an admin dashboard, bringing a clear public experience and manageable content into one platform.

projects.title: Rheinland Consultancy
projects.description: A web platform connecting candidates in India with overseas career opportunities through a Germany-based consultancy.

testimonials.name: Aisha Rahman
testimonials.quote: Praveen translated a rough idea into a shipping SaaS product. Clean architecture, sharp UI, and zero hand-holding required.
